verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧ : ਗੁਰੂ ਤੁੱਲ ਕੁਛ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 21 : guroo tu'l kuchh nahee(n) hai

en.bdb: Nothing is there equal to Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਲਖ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaar padhaarath aakheean lakh padhaarath hukamee ba(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Four ideals (dharma arth kam and moks) are said to be but such millions of ideals are servants (of Lord, the Guru).

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਖ ਸੇਵਕੀ ਕਾਮਧੇਣੁ ਲਖ ਵਗ ਚਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: ridh sidh nidh lakh sevakee kaamadhen lakh vag chara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In His service are millions of miraculous powers and treasures and He has herds of wish fulfilling cows grazing there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਥਰੋਲੀਆ ਪਾਰਜਾਤਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਗ ਫਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh paaras patharoleeaa paarajaat lakh baag fala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: He has lakhs of philosopher's stones and gardens of fruitful wish fulfilling trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਵਣ ਲਖ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣੀ ਲਖ ਰਸਾਇਣ ਕਰਦੇ ਛੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: chitavan lakh chi(n)taamanee lakh rasain karadhe chha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: At one wink of the Guru, lakhs of wish fulfilling gems (chintamini) and elixirs are sacrifice unto Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਰਤਨ ਰਤਨਾਗਰਾ ਸਭ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਸਿਮਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh ratan ratanaagaraa sabh nidhaan sabh fal simara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Millions of jewels, all the treasures of oceans and all the fruits recite his praises.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਖ ਭਗਤ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਚੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lakh bhagatee lakh bhagat hoi karaamaat parachai paracha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Millions of devotees and miracle mongers move around engrossed in hypocrisies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv saadhasa(n)g piram piaalaa ajar jara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The true disciple of the Guru, merging their consciousness in the Word, drinks and assimilates the unbearable cup of the love of the Lord.
By the grace of the Guru, people come and join the holy congregation.
